The Connect form

Cut out of the live pages, with their own CSS: this is the markup the Hugo templates have to produce. Header, footer, buttons, links, tags and fields (React-rendered, the same markup the static pages carry) are on states.html. Also: Cards, breadcrumbs, search, pagination.

Form: Connect with a scientist

The Connect panel of an expert page as it looks when opened (it is a modal on the live page; here it sits in the flow). The reCAPTCHA slot is empty: Google draws it. The footer form (Want to help?) is in the Footer specimen on states.html.
